tiny.fnt / tiny_xml.fnt / tiny.png: a 2-glyph BMFont (A and V are solid 3x4 blocks, kerning A-V -1)
made by hand for the font tests (CC0, part of alpha-star's tests).

noto/: Noto Sans (Latin), Noto Sans Arabic and Noto Sans SC subsets for the shaping, bidi,
fallback and wrapping tests, cut with tools/subset_fonts.py from the notofonts releases
(SIL Open Font License 1.1: noto/OFL.txt, noto/OFL-NotoSansCJK.txt).
